content: {"episode_id":"ep-05036","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for missing prior authorization. The clinical indication note documents recurrent dizziness and giddiness clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate the correlation between these symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes."}
